name: paper figure-legend settings, 2026-11-13
purpose: Rerun of the paper's section 5 experiment with the learning rates printed in the Figure 1 and Figure 2 legends and the loss of eq. 3.1; presented on the slides from 2026-11-13
paper: Zhang, Zou, Cao, The Implicit Bias of Adam on Separable Data, NeurIPS 2024, section 5 and Figures 1-2
datasets: results/2026-11-05/datasets (same ten PCG64 datasets, same initial vectors, same selected seed 2)
loss_note: Averaged over the 50 samples, as in eq. 3.1.
gd_gdm_learning_rate_source: Figure 1 legend: GD and GDM with eta_t = 0.1
adam_learning_rate_source: Figure 1 and 2 legends write eta_t = t^-a, i.e. c = 1; the text writes Theta(t^-a). Only the start of the count (t = 1) is our choice.
primary_adam_a_source: Figure 1 legend: Adam with eta_t = t^-0.5
arithmetic: Same common exponential rescaling of the Adam moments as run.py; epsilon kept at its real size (epsilon*e^scale in the rescaled denominator); no clamp
disclosure: All learning rates are the legends' values; the only unstated choice is that t counts from 1. The 2026-11-05 first run and the 2026-11-12 c = 0.1 / summed-loss variant are kept unchanged.
